verdict.rationale: Mem0 publishes a live OpenAPI spec and code-snippet quickstarts (e.g. client.add examples), which are the raw materials for an interactive reference, but no evidence describes an actual browsable/try-it-out API console with runnable examples. missing for 10: explicit interactive API reference UI (e.g. Swagger/Redoc try-it-out), evidence of runnable/executable examples within docs, independent confirmation of this experience.
